messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: model=embedding-v2, traffic=10% -> autoscaler bumped to 30% · error_rate(/v1/generate)=18% 5m avg > canary_threshold(5%). Alerting SRE.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall @alice (oncall) — high canary error rate for embedding-v2. Incident channel created.
alice (oncall): I'm on it. Quick ask: is this degrading user-facing responses or internal metrics only?
bob_sre: I see 5xx bursts from the inference service and timeouts hitting the GPU nodes. Clients are seeing partial responses and increased latency. Customer-facing.
dan-engineer: logs show repeated exceptions in tokenizer step after switching to model shard layout. Sample stack:
```
Err: TokenizerError: unexpected byte 0x00
 at Tokenizer.parse (/src/tokenizer/index.js:232:19)
 at InferenceEngine.generate (/src/engine/runner.py:410)
```
This started at 1960583200 close to deploy window.
carla-pm: CS is getting 3 tickets flagged as "generation failures" — two enterprise customers impacted. We should minimize blast radius.
eve-support: Adding customer thread links: https://support.reports/INC-9921 , https://support.reports/INC-9922 — both report truncated outputs and 500 errors.
alice (oncall): Proposed mitigation: flip model feature flag back to previous variant OR rollback canary. Which is faster?
dan-engineer: Feature flag kill-switch is fastest if available. We have a LaunchDarkly toggle `use_embedding_v2`. If ops can flip it, that should route to v1 immediately.
ops-bot: Flag endpoint healthy. 3 nodes responding. Recommend coordinated flip + health checks.
bob_sre: If flag flip isn't propagated fast enough, we should prepare manual rollback of the deployment. I'll prepare commands.
alice (oncall): Ops, please do the flag flip. Dan, stand by to validate. Bob, coordinate rollback steps as fallback.
ops-bot: Executing kill-switch: `POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggles/use_embedding_v2 -> false`
ops-bot: Response 200. Propagation batch sent to edge nodes.
dan-engineer: Watching logs. I see clients hitting model_v1 variant now:
```
[1960583368] routed_request: user=svc-frontend model=embedding-v1 latency=120ms
```
latency normalizing.
alice (oncall): Can we confirm error rate drop?
bob_sre: Running quick metrics check: 
```
> select error_rate from infra.metrics where service='inference' and window='5m'
result: 2.1% (was 18%)
```
Significant improvement. Keep monitoring for 10 minutes.
eve-support: Notifying affected customers that we've reverted to the safe variant and are investigating root cause. Message posted in customer threads.
carla-pm: Good. Are there any degraded batch jobs or long-running pipelines that need manual restart due to the flip?
dan-engineer: A couple of async ingestion workers hit retries during the spike. I'll restart the worker job CRs in non-prod first then prod.
ops-bot: Restart commands queued: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/inference-workers --timeout=5m`
bob_sre: Also checking for cache eviction side effects — prefix cache might have warmed for new keyspace with v2. We'll allow a brief cold-cache period.
alice (oncall): Verification checklist:
- error rate < 5% across all regions (bob)
- customer-facing errors resolved (eve)
- worker queues drained or restarted (dan)
- no pending alerts for model=embedding-v2 (ops)
- postmortem ticket created (carla)

Everyone ack each item as you complete.
bob_sre: error rate < 5% in us-east/us-west/eu (verified). Metrics window 10m: 1.9%.
eve-support: Customer tickets updated — customers confirm degradations stopped.
dan-engineer: restarted workers; queues draining. No backlog > 5k messages.
ops-bot: No active rollout for embedding-v2 canary (traffic=0%). Deployment paused.
alice (oncall): All checks green. I'll close the incident after 30m of stable metrics. Start postmortem and include rollout config and tokenizer changes.
carla-pm: Postmortem ticket created: PM-INC-196058. Assigning to dan-engineer and bob_sre. Please include timeline and suggested rollback gating for future canaries.
dan-engineer: Initial theory: subtle tokenizer regression when model shard layout changed; fails on certain byte sequences. I'll reproduce locally, adding test cases.
bob_sre: We should add a pre-rollout smoke test that runs inference on edge-case token sequences and checks for exceptions. I'll add to the rollout gating checklist.
eve-support: Closing customer comms loop: customers are satisfied with the mitigation. Keeping incident open until postmortem done.
alice (oncall): Thanks team. Moving to monitoring-only. If anything flares, reopen here. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident automated summary will be posted to #incidents-log in 10m. Incident duration so far ~8m.
alice (oncall): Marking handoff for follow-up to bob_sre and dan-engineer for root cause. I'll sign off after postmortem draft.
bob_sre: ACK. I'll take the follow-ups on rollout gating and alert thresholds.
dan-engineer: ACK. Will push a patch to tokenizer and schedule a canary with additional unit tests.
incident-bot: :information_source: Incident resolved (mitigated) — mitigation action: feature-flag toggle `use_embedding_v2=false`. Please attach timeline and logs to PM-INC-196058.
alice (oncall): Closing thread for now. Good quick coordination — nice work. :thumbsup:
